news.title: Netflix Stock Is Down 36% and Wall Street Keeps Downgrading It. History Says That's a Mistake.
news.summary: The streaming giant's rising profitability may help improve overall investor sentiment in the coming months.
news.title_zh: Netflix 股價下跌 36% 且華爾街持續下調評級。歷史表明這是個錯誤。
news.summary_zh: 這家串流巨頭不斷提升的獲利能力可能有助於改善未來幾個月的整體投資人情緒。

news.title: Josh Brown: Netflix Can Clear Wall Street’s 10.6% Growth Bar “Standing on Their Head”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysJosh Brown says Netflix can easily beat Wall Street’s 2027 revenue growth estimate, which sits below the 13% growth Netflix guides for 2026. At about 17x forward earnings, Netflix trades at roughly half its five-year average multiple, about Disney’s.
news.title_zh: Josh Brown：Netflix 可輕鬆跨越華爾街的 10.6% 成長門檻，「倒立」也能過關
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Josh Brown 指出 Netflix 可輕易擊敗華爾街的 2027 營收成長預估，該預估低於 Netflix 為 2026 指引的 13% 成長。以約 17x 遠期盈餘計算，Netflix 交易價格約為其五年平均倍數的一半，接近 Disney。

news.title: Fixing Netflix's Growing Subscriber Satisfaction Problem
news.summary: The likelihood of users recommending Netflix or Net Promoter Score is now +51 vs. +53 a year ago, according to Worldpanel by Numerator, a consumer and shopper behavior researcher.
news.title_zh: 解決 Netflix 日益嚴重的訂戶滿意度問題
news.summary_zh: 根據消費者與購物行為研究機構 Numerator 的 Worldpanel 數據，用戶推薦 Netflix 的可能性或淨推薦分數目前為 +51，而一年前為 +53。

news.title: Why Netflix's Fall Could Pay Off At Tax Time
news.summary: Today's big story: Could Anthropic Stock Fall 25.
news.title_zh: 為何 Netflix 下跌在報稅時可能獲利
news.summary_zh: 今日重大消息：Anthropic 股票會下跌 25 嗎？

news.title: Netflix Just Dropped 15% in a Month. Is There “More Pain” Ahead, or Is It Time to Load Up?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysNetflix stock fell 15% in the past month after a soft fourth-quarter outlook and a cut to its 2026 ad revenue forecast, to about $2. 7 billion from about $3 billion.
news.title_zh: Netflix 一個月內下跌 15%。未來還有「更多痛苦」，還是該加碼買進？
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要：Netflix 股價在過去一個月下跌 15%，因第四季展望疲軟且將其 2026 廣告收入預測下調至約 $2。7 billion 從約 $3 billion。

news.title: With Netflix Stock Down Nearly 46% In The Last Year, Michael Burry Reveals The Price He’d Think About Buying
news.summary: Michael Burry says Netflix has finally caught his eye, but only at a price far below where it trades today. His shifting number, and a milk versus wine theory about content, reveal what he thinks a streaming library is really worth.
news.title_zh: Netflix 股價在過去一年下跌近 46%，Michael Burry 揭露他考慮買進的價格
news.summary_zh: Michael Burry 表示 Netflix 終於引起他的注意，但僅限於遠低於當前交易價格的水平。他不斷變動的數字，以及關於內容的「牛奶對葡萄酒」理論，揭示了他認為串流媒體庫的真實價值。

news.title: What Are Netflix Stock Bears Missing?
news.summary: Today's big story: Could Anthropic Stock Fall 25.
news.title_zh: Netflix 空頭錯過了什麼？
news.summary_zh: 今日大事：Anthropic 股價會下跌 25 嗎？

news.title: Netflix Is 48% Below Its High While Guiding to Record Revenue of $51.1 Billion, Up 13%, for 2026
news.summary: Key TakeawaysNetflix hit a new 52-week low this week, 48% below its high a year ago, while guiding 2026 revenue to a record $51. 1 billion.
news.title_zh: Netflix 低於其高點 48%，同時指引創紀錄收入 $51.1 Billion，增長 13%，針對 2026
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點Netflix 本週觸及新的 52 週低點，較一年前高點低 48%，同時指引 2026 收入達創紀錄的 $51。1 billion.

news.title: Nick Khan on Making WWE a Global Media Power
news.summary: In this episode of The Deal, Alex Rodriguez and Jason Kelly talk with WWE president Nick Khan at Bloomberg’s Screentime conference about his deals with Netflix and ESPN. (Source: Bloomberg)
news.title_zh: Nick Khan 談打造 WWE 成為全球媒體強權
news.summary_zh: 在《The Deal》這一集中，Alex Rodriguez 和 Jason Kelly 在彭博 Screentime 大會上與 WWE 總裁 Nick Khan 對談，討論他與 Netflix 和 ESPN 的交易。（來源：彭博）

news.title: Skydance Skips FIFA World Cup Bid as Netflix, Fox Eye $4 Billion Deal
news.summary: Skydance Corp. and Walt Disney Co.’s ESPN have declined to bid for the US media rights for the next FIFA Men’s World Cup tournament in what could be one of the costliest and competitive auctions in the global soccer event’s history, according to people familiar with the matter.
news.title_zh: Skydance 放棄 FIFA 世界盃標案，Netflix、Fox 覬覦 $4 Billion 交易
news.summary_zh: 據知情人士透露，Skydance Corp. 和 Walt Disney Co. 旗下的 ESPN 已拒絕競標下一屆 FIFA 男子世界盃賽事的美國媒體版權，這可能是全球足球賽事歷史上最昂貴且競爭最激烈的拍賣之一。

news.title: Josh Brown Says Netflix Trades at 16 Times Next Year’s Earnings After a 50% Drop. Is It a Buy?
news.summary: Josh Brown once called Netflix his biggest mistake of the year, then watched the stock sink even further. Now he sees a bargain hiding in the wreckage, but the bear case has real teeth, and one upcoming report could settle the debate.
news.title_zh: Josh Brown 指出 Netflix 交易價為 16 Times 倍明年盈利，此前下跌 50%。是否值得買入？
news.summary_zh: Josh Brown 曾稱 Netflix 為他年度最大錯誤，隨後目睹股價進一步下挫。如今他看見殘局中藏著便宜貨，但空頭論點確有威力，即將到來的一份報告可能終結辯論。

news.title: Netflix Stock Just Closed Below $60 for the First Time Since August 2024. I'd Buy It Now.
news.summary: The streaming giant's shares have hit the price I said I'd pay. Is there a good reason to wait longer?
news.title_zh: Netflix 股價剛收盤跌破 $60，為自 August 2024 以來首次。我現在會買入。
news.summary_zh: 這家串流巨頭的股價已觸及我說會買入的價格。還有好的理由再等待嗎？

news.title: Bond ETFs Haven’t Been This Rewarding in Years, So Why Is Wall Street Dumping Them?
news.summary: Investors are fleeing bond funds just as new bonds pay the most in years. One yield level will decide whether the exodus was smart or a costly mistake for anyone holding the safe 40% of a portfolio.
news.title_zh: 債券 ETF 多年來最具吸引力，為何華爾街卻在拋售？
news.summary_zh: 投資人正逃離債券基金，就在此時新債券殖利率創多年新高。某一殖利率水準將決定這波出逃對持有投資組合安全 40% 的人來說，是明智之舉還是昂貴錯誤。

news.title: A Monthly Check at 3 Levels of Risk: VTEB, TLT and EMB, Ranked
news.summary: A retiree's monthly bond fund check can stay steady while the share price behind it quietly collapses. Ranking three popular payers on both risks produces two lists that point in opposite directions, and one fund flips from safe to scary.
news.title_zh: 在 3 風險層級的每月檢視：VTEB、TLT 與 EMB 排名
news.summary_zh: 退休族的每月債券基金檢視可能看似穩定，但背後的股價卻悄悄崩塌。根據兩種風險對三檔熱門配息基金排名，產生兩份方向相反的名單，且有一檔基金從安全變得驚悚。

news.title: Some Fed Officials Wanted to Hike in October. A Half-Point Hike Is on the Table.
news.summary: Fed minutes revealed a hawkish bloc bigger than the October vote let on, and Governor Waller says the central bank may need to shock people. Long bond holders now face a fork where one path rescues them and the other keeps squeezing.
news.title_zh: 部分聯準會官員想在十月升息。半碼升息在考慮範圍內。
news.summary_zh: 聯準會會議記錄揭示鷹派陣營比十月投票顯示的更大，Waller 總裁表示央行可能需要震懾市場。長債持有者現在面臨岔路，一條路能救他們，另一條則持續擠壓。

news.title: Two More Days Above 5% and Treasury Yields Tie 2007’s Run
news.summary: The 10-year yield has spent four straight sessions above a line it rarely crosses, and a bond auction plus Fed minutes arrive within hours. Whether the streak survives could decide what happens next for long-bond holders.
news.title_zh: 再維持 5% 以上兩天，公債殖利率將追平 2007 的紀錄
news.summary_zh: 10 年期殖利率已連續四個交易日站上鮮少觸及的關鍵線，且債券拍賣與聯準會會議紀錄將在數小時內公布。這波連續漲勢能否延續，將決定長債持有者的後續走向。

news.title: Traders Now See a 95% Chance the Fed Hikes Rates in December
news.summary: A December hike looks like a lock, yet the Treasury market that matters most for long-bond holders answers to a different signal. Fed officials are split on how far this cycle runs, and TLT owners may be watching the wrong number.
news.title_zh: 交易員現在認為聯準會在十二月升息的機率為 95%
news.summary_zh: 十二月升息看起來鐵定會發生，但對長期債券持有者最重要的國債市場卻回應不同的訊號。聯準會官員對這輪循環能走多遠意見分歧，TLT 持有者可能正在關注錯誤的數字。

news.title: The Government Spends About $5.5 Billion a Day More Than It Takes In. The Debt Has Doubled in 10 Years. Jaime Dimon This the Situation Could Get Much Worse.
news.summary: Washington borrows over a trillion dollars a year just to pay interest on what it already owes, and two of Wall Street's most powerful executives are warning the pressure on bond markets has not yet reached its peak.
news.title_zh: 政府每天支出比收入多約 $5.5 Billion。債務在 10 年內翻倍。Jaime Dimon 認為情況可能會惡化得更嚴重。
news.summary_zh: 華盛頓每年借入超過一兆美元僅為支付現有債務利息，華爾街兩大權勢人物警告債券市場壓力尚未達到頂峰。

news.title: Bessent Tells the Fed Not to Hike “Too Much”
news.summary: Treasury wants the Fed to ease off while the officials who actually vote on rates lean the other way. Long-bond holders sit in the middle of that standoff, and two December dates could decide who wins.
news.title_zh: Bessent 告訴聯準會不要加息「太多」
news.summary_zh: 財政部希望聯準會緩手，而實際投票決定利率的官員則傾向相反方向。長期債券持有者處於這場對峙的中間，而十二月的兩個日期可能決定誰獲勝。

news.title: Kevin Warsh’s Fed Will Vote on Rates Only 7 Times in 2027
news.summary: The Fed is quietly trimming its meeting calendar, and long-term Treasuries already flinched. With a hike looming in December, fewer decision days could make every surprise hit bond holders harder. Which corner of the bond market gets hurt most?
news.title_zh: Kevin Warsh 的聯準會將僅在 2027 對利率投票 7 Times 次

news.title: Anthropic Slumps as AI Selloff Deepens
news.summary: Anthropic shares fell in premarket trading as a broad market selloff and doubts about the AI trade overshadowed the optimism that had fueled a rally on its record-setting debut. Apple is developing its own autonomous AI agent that can get things done on behalf of users, looking to enter a fast-growing market already being pursued by OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta and others. A gauge of global stocks is heading for its longest losing streak in three years as the AI trade undergoes a sharp unravelling, putting this year’s broader equity gains at risk and roiling metal markets. Today’s guests: Themos Fiotakis, Barclays Global Head of FX Strategy & EM Macro Strategy; Jill Rutter, Institute for Government Senior Fellow; Vas Narasimhan, Novartis CEO (Source: Bloomberg)
news.title_zh: 隨著 AI 拋售加深，Anthropic 股價下跌
news.summary_zh: Anthropic 股價在盤前交易中下跌，廣泛的市場拋售和對 AI 交易的疑慮，蓋過了其創紀錄首秀所激發的樂觀情緒。蘋果正在開發自己的自主 AI 代理，能代表用戶完成任務，旨在進入一個快速增長的市場，而 OpenAI、Anthropic、Meta 等公司已在追逐該市場。全球股票指標將迎來三年來最長連跌，因 AI 交易經歷急劇解體，使今年更廣泛的股票漲幅面臨風險，並震盪金屬市場。今日嘉賓：Themos Fiotakis，巴克萊全球外匯策略主管兼新興市場宏觀策略主管；Jill Rutter，政府研究所資深研究員；Vas Narasimhan，諾華 CEO（來源：彭博社）

Apple is developing its own autonomous AI agent that can get things done on behalf of users, looking to enter a fast-growing market already being pursued by OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta and others. news.summary_zh: Oklo 沒有營運中的發電廠，擁有 $3.1 billion 現金緩衝，股價持續下滑，而華爾街的目標價遠高於此。真正的問題是哪些里程碑能改變劇本，哪些會讓它崩盤。

news.title: NuScale Sinks 22% in a Week to a 52-Week Low as Canada’s First SMR Runs Late. Is the Selling Overdone?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysNuScale fell 22% in a week to a 52-week low after Canada’s first GE Vernova Hitachi small modular reactor ran late and over budget. Oklo fell too, but NuScale, still without a binding module order, fell about twice as much.
news.title_zh: NuScale 下跌 22% 於一週內至 52 週低點，因加拿大首座 SMR 延遲。賣壓是否過度？

news.title: Meta’s Prepayment Is Buying Oklo’s Nuclear Fuel for Up to Five Reactors
news.summary: Key TakeawaysOklo (OKLO) signed definitive agreements with Centrus Energy (LEU) on November 12 to secure enough nuclear fuel for up to five Aurora powerhouses, with deliveries starting in 2029. Meta Platforms (META) is helping finance fuel purchases for Oklo’s planned 1.
news.title_zh: Meta 的預付款正在為 Oklo 的最多五座反應堆購買核燃料
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點Oklo (OKLO) 於 November 12 與 Centrus Energy (LEU) 簽署最終協議，確保最多五座 Aurora 發電廠所需的核燃料，交付將於 2029 開始。Meta Platforms (META) 正在協助為 Oklo 計劃的 1 融資採購燃料。

news.title: Oklo Sits Near Its 52-Week Low After a 5-Reactor Fuel Deal. Is It Time to Sell, or Load Up?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysOklo signed definitive contracts with Centrus Energy for enough HALEU to run up to five Aurora powerhouses, with deliveries starting in 2029. Meta’s prepayment for future power supports the purchase, and Centrus now counts $5.
news.title_zh: Oklo 處於其 52 週低點附近，在 5 反應爐燃料交易後。是賣出還是加碼時機？
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要 Oklo 與 Centrus Energy 簽署最終合約，取得足夠 HALEU 燃料最多運轉五座 Aurora 電廠，交貨自 2029 開始。Meta 為未來電力預付款支持採購，Centrus 現計有 $5。

news.title: Oklo Has Lost 76% in a Year. Wall Street Still Sees $56. Bullish Wedbush Sees Just $36
news.summary: Key TakeawaysOklo has lost 76% in a year, and analysts’ average price target has fallen from $103 to $56. Wedbush repeated its Outperform rating and $36 target on Nov.
news.title_zh: Oklo 一年虧損 76%。華爾街仍看好 $56。看漲的 Wedbush 僅看 $36
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點Oklo 一年虧損 76%，分析師平均目標價已從 $103 to $56 下調。Wedbush 重申其跑贏大盤評級及 $36 目標價，於十一月。

news.title: AMD Soars 6%, Broadcom Up 6% as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Exits
news.summary: Key TakeawaysAMD shares jumped 6% after Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia’s CEO, and Broadcom rose with it. IonQ, SoundHound and Oklo fell instead, as investors cut back on the riskiest AI bets.
news.title_zh: AMD 飆漲 6%，Broadcom 上漲 6%，隨著 Nvidia CEO 黃仁勳離職
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點 AMD 股價在黃仁勳辭去 Nvidia CEO 後跳升 6%，Broadcom 同步上漲。IonQ、SoundHound 和 Oklo 則下跌，因投資人減碼最具風險的 AI 押注。

news.title: Craig-Hallum Just Cut Its Oklo Target From $53 to $27 After a Better-Than-Expected Quarter
news.summary: Key TakeawaysCraig-Hallum cut its Oklo price target to $27 from $53 on Nov. 9 and kept its Hold rating, three days after Oklo reported a narrower third-quarter loss than expected.
news.title_zh: Craig-Hallum 在優於預期的季度後將 Oklo 目標價從 $53 to $27 下調
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Craig-Hallum 於 Nov. 9 將 Oklo 目標價從 $53 下調至 $27，並維持持有評級，這是在 Oklo 報告第三季虧損縮小優於預期的三天後。

news.title: Oklo Gets Final DOE Operational Clearance For Groves-1 Reactor – Retail Eyes 85% Upside By 2026-End
news.summary: The DOE’s operational restriction clearance will allow the reactor to enter its research, testing, and training phase.
news.title_zh: Oklo 獲得 DOE 核准 Groves-1 反應爐最終運營許可 – 散戶關注 2026 年底前 85% 上漲空間
news.summary_zh: DOE 的運營限制許可將允許反應爐進入研究、測試和訓練階段。

news.title: Oklo Rises 4% as DOE Clears Groves-1 Reactor for Unrestricted Operations: “Reset the Nuclear Industry’s Expectations”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysOklo shares jumped 4% today after the Department of Energy cleared its Groves-1 test reactor for unrestricted operations. Groves-1 shows Oklo can build fast, but it still needs a cost for its first Aurora powerhouse and a binding customer.
news.title_zh: Oklo 上漲 4%，因 DOE 核准 Groves-1 反應爐進行無限制運營：「重設核能產業期望」
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Oklo 股價今日跳升 4%，因能源部核准其 Groves-1 試驗反應爐進行無限制運營。Groves-1 顯示 Oklo 能快速建設，但仍需首座 Aurora 電廠的成本和具約束力的客戶。

news.title: Oklo Receives DOE Clearance for Groves-1 Reactor Research, Testing and Training Operations
news.summary: Oklo Inc. (NYSE:OKLO) announced that the US Department of Energy (DOE) has cleared the final operations hold point for its Groves Isotope Test Reactor (Groves-1) in Lockhart, Texas, allowing the facility to proceed with research, testing and personnel training activities.
news.title_zh: Oklo 獲得 DOE 批准 Groves-1 反應爐研究、測試和培訓運營
news.summary_zh: Oklo Inc. (NYSE:OKLO) 宣佈美國能源部 (DOE) 已批准其 Groves 同位素測試反應爐 (Groves-1) 位於德克薩斯州洛克哈特) 的最終運營控制點,允許該設施繼續進行研究、測試和人員培訓活動。

news.title: Oklo Soars 14% in a Week on a Narrower Loss and a Deal for 27 Reactors’ Worth of Forgings
news.summary: Key TakeawaysOklo stock rose 14% in the week to Nov. 9 on a narrower third-quarter loss and a forging deal for 27 reactors.
news.title_zh: Oklo 因虧損收窄和 27 反應堆鍛件交易，一週內飆升 14%
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Oklo 股價在截至 Nov. 9 的一週內上漲 14%，得益於第三季虧損收窄和 27 反應堆的鍛件交易。

news.summary: Key TakeawaysBrad Gerstner’s Altimeter Capital opened a $680 million Tesla position in the third quarter, added to Meta Platforms and Micron, and sold out of Qualcomm and Applied Materials. Tesla trades at about 180x forward earnings, and analysts’ average target is just 7% above the price, so the new stake is a bet on Robotaxi profits that the estimates don’t show yet.
